notes.summary: Continuation defining an induced subfigure, C7_0, a statement that the symmetric assertion is false, and a planned strengthening. The lower proposed comparison of two conditions is worked and broadly cancelled. Every text group and graphical mark was read from this page; the supplied witnesses remained drafts.
notes.math_reading_decisions: No mathematical argument was used to choose letters or signs. The different lower strokes of the straight and bowed orders prompted local visual comparison only. The final open C/G was not normalized to the preceding G-prime. Double shafts, rather than the expected logical implication, settled the last arrow. The author’s assertions were transcribed, not validated.
notes.author_checks: The parenthesis says the symmetric assertion is false, without an example on this page. The lower a-to-b claim attributed to C6 has its own crossing rule. The last b-to-a attribution to C7_0 is physically below the broad diagonal endpoints; whether the author included it in the overall cancellation remains open.
notes.title_dates_pagination: Manuscript folio 72 is clear at the top; scan marker 73 retained. The only proposed lower heading is locally scribbled out and remains doubtful. No date, title sheet or overall page count appears.
notes.h_placeholder_alignment: The opening struck placeholder maps to the cancelled primed capital; the three marginal placeholders map jointly to the three-line note; the isolated struck placeholder in the On paragraph maps to the small mark before the second C7 (H placed it before the first C7_0); the lower opening placeholder maps to the crossed title. No placeholder was silently discarded.
notes.h_editorial_notes: H’s statements that the draft has two diagonal strokes and that the inserted wording is underlined are editorial descriptions, not manuscript words. The image shows three diagonals and a hooked insertion enclosure beneath the full Considérons les phrase. H’s later correction that the top square sign is worked rather than separately struck is consistent with preserving its worked strokes and the independent broad diagonal.
notes.scope_of_graphic_states: Deletion and insertion state in the composite lower group is carried by the literal drawing. No extra horizontal strike was added across an entire line merely to replace a long diagonal. Ordinary overwritten capitals still use the prescribed old-before-new convention. The final line’s unsure wrapper concerns only block-cancellation scope.
notes.source_scope: Only this assigned page packet, the supplied conventions and notation snapshot, and this reader’s own output were used. The unrelated cross-page tail initially present in C_context was disregarded. No other scans, reader files, OCR, research, delegation or LaTeX compilation were used.
